entries.meaning: Allele frequency clipped at 0: gnomAD AF (cohort column, else gnomAD join), else the 1000 Genomes global AF; a variant with no frequency becomes 0.0. (finngen.py's comment calls FinnGen a third AF fallback; FinnGenConnector does not write allele_freq.)
entries.name: af_raw
entries.reason: Population allele frequency is measured, unsupervised evidence of purifying selection. It is also the evidence of ACMG/AMP BA1, BS1 and PM2, so the label was partly assigned from it (annotation circularity, recorded in label_criterion_use); 1D-2 must report a criterion-independent evaluation. Absence is not separable from a failed join (MISSINGNESS-SEMANTICS-1); the representation, not the information, is defective.

entries.reason: Derived from the variant's own reference and alternate alleles; no external source, no supervision. In-frame length change is PM4 evidence, recorded as label-criterion use.

entries.name: len_diff
entries.reason: Derived from the variant's own reference and alternate alleles; no external source, no supervision. In-frame length change is PM4 evidence, recorded as label-criterion use.

entries.meaning: CADD PHRED-scaled score from dbNSFP (or the optional REST connector); absent 15.0.
entries.name: cadd_phred
entries.reason: Trained to separate simulated variants from human-derived alleles: a non-clinical proxy objective. It is PP3/BP4 evidence (ClinGen calibration), recorded as label-criterion use.

entries.meaning: SIFT score in [0,1] from dbNSFP; absent 0.5 (the code's neutral fill).
entries.name: sift_score
entries.reason: Homology-based and unsupervised. PP3/BP4 evidence, recorded as label-criterion use.

entries.meaning: PolyPhen-2 HDIV probability from dbNSFP; absent 0.5.
entries.name: polyphen2_score
entries.reason: Trained on HumDiv: UniProtKB damaging alleles of Mendelian disease against divergence from close mammalian homologs -- clinically supervised, with unknown overlap with the ClinVar-labelled cohort (type-1 circularity, Grimm et al. 2015). Admissible only in an evaluation cohort verified disjoint from its training data (for example a time split after the tool's release), as a separately versioned claim.

entries.meaning: REVEL ensemble score in [0,1] from dbNSFP; absent 0.5.
entries.name: revel_score
entries.reason: Trained on HGMD disease mutations against rare putatively neutral variants: clinically supervised, overlap with the ClinVar label set unknown and plausibly large (type-1 circularity). Conditional on a verified-disjoint evaluation cohort.

entries.meaning: phyloP conservation: the dbNSFP phyloP100way value where dbNSFP covers the variant, the PhyloP BigWig connector otherwise; the two producers are not reconciled (PHYLOP-RECONCILE-1). Absent 0.0.
entries.name: phylop_score
entries.reason: Unsupervised evolutionary conservation; admissible. The unreconciled double producer is a representation defect already registered as PHYLOP-RECONCILE-1.

entries.meaning: GERP++ rejected-substitution score from dbNSFP; absent 0.0.
entries.name: gerp_score
entries.reason: Unsupervised evolutionary constraint.

entries.meaning: AlphaMissense pathogenicity in [0,1] joined by chrom:pos:ref:alt; absent 0.5.
entries.name: alphamissense_score
entries.reason: Fine-tuned on weak labels from population frequency (common human and primate variants as benign); its published class thresholds were set on ClinVar but no threshold is used here. Admissible; PP3/BP4-type evidence recorded as label-criterion use.

entries.meaning: max(DS_AG, DS_AL, DS_DG, DS_DL) over overlapping genes; absent 0.0.
entries.name: splice_ai_score
entries.reason: Trained on annotated GENCODE splice junctions, not on clinical labels. PP3/BP7 evidence for splicing (ClinGen 2023), recorded as label-criterion use.

entries.meaning: EVE score in [0,1]; the connector fills unmatched variants with 0.5 and counts coverage as score != 0.5, so a genuine 0.5 is counted uncovered. Run 15: connector unconfigured, every row the default.
entries.name: eve_score
entries.reason: Pinned CONDITIONAL_ONLY (ruling c34eb717): admissible only within a frozen exact-variant-matched stratum (protein accession and isoform, reference residue, position, source release), coverage determined by join membership, never by value; scores are normalised within protein (EVE-COVERAGE-IDENTITY-1).

entries.meaning: 1 when cadd_phred >= 20 (top 1% of all possible substitutions by construction).
entries.name: cadd_high
entries.reason: A fixed cut of an admitted score; the cut is rank-based, not fitted to clinical labels.

entries.meaning: 1 when sift_score < 0.05 (absent variants, filled 0.5, are 0).
entries.name: sift_deleterious
entries.reason: A fixed cut of an admitted score. The provenance of the conventional 0.05 cut was not verified in this review (recorded as unknown); a single fixed cut-point can carry at most one fitted scalar, so it adds no label information beyond its admitted score.

entries.meaning: 1 when polyphen2_score >= 0.908 (the HDIV 'probably damaging' cut).
entries.name: polyphen_probably_damaging
entries.reason: Inherits polyphen2_score's clinical supervision; its cut was itself set on the HumDiv disease set.

entries.meaning: 1 when revel_score >= 0.5.
entries.name: revel_pathogenic
entries.reason: Inherits revel_score's clinical supervision and conditional admission.

entries.meaning: Sum of cadd_high, sift_deleterious, polyphen_probably_damaging and revel_pathogenic.
entries.name: n_tools_pathogenic
entries.reason: Two of its four terms are clinically supervised; a sum cannot be more admissible than its least admissible term (monotone admission).

entries.meaning: gnomAD lof.oe, the observed/expected loss-of-function ratio (NaN preserved when unmeasured).
entries.name: gene_constraint_oe
entries.reason: Gene-level mutational constraint from a population mutation-rate model: no clinical labels, transferable to unseen genes. Defaults for genes without a measurement are values (MISSINGNESS-SEMANTICS-1).

entries.meaning: 1.0 when LOEUF < 0.35 (retained project policy; gnomAD v4.1.1 recommends 0.45), NaN when LOEUF is unmeasured.
entries.name: gene_is_constrained
entries.reason: Gene-level mutational constraint from a population mutation-rate model: no clinical labels, transferable to unseen genes. Defaults for genes without a measurement are values (MISSINGNESS-SEMANTICS-1).

registered_defects.statement: EVE coverage is inferred from the value: the connector fills unmatched variants with 0.5 and counts coverage as score != 0.5, so a genuine 0.5 is uncovered; the 1D-1 audit's measurement compared standardised matrices with raw defaults (withdrawn, docs/census/measure_1d1_correction.json).

evidence_refs: code:src/genomic_variant_classifier/models/variant_ensemble.py#All missing columns are filled with safe defaults (df.get)
registered_defects.statement: (Registered by the owner, decision file 25691d66.) engineer_features fills an absent source with a value that is also a valid observation (0.5 for SIFT, PolyPhen-2, REVEL, AlphaMissense, EVE and both GNN scores; 15.0 for CADD; 0.0 for conservation, splicing, language-model, frequency and count features; 1.0 for LOEUF and FinnGen enrichment), so no model can tell 'not observed' from 'observed at the default'. The observation contract (value, status, source identity) is stage 1D-1b.

The run driver injects RAW gnn_score and hetero_gnn_score into matrices whose other columns are StandardScaler outputs, after the scaler was fitted on the constant default; inference instead adds gnn_score BEFORE scaling (a scaler fitted on a constant 0.5 has scale 1 and mean 0.5, so inference sees g - 0.5 where evaluation saw g) and never computes hetero_gnn_score. Measured on Run 15: persisted gnn_score spans [0.0012, 0.5] while cadd_phred has mean 0 and standard deviation 1.

evidence_refs: code:scripts/run_phase2_eval.py#c for c in X_train.columns if c != "gnn_score"
registered_defects.statement: GNN node attributes are every training column but gnn_score -- including the retired label count n_pathogenic_in_gene, lovd_variant_class and cosmic_sig_tier and the excluded curated gene-disease features -- and the GNN is trained on the same training labels, so gnn_score inherits every retired and excluded dependency (measured_dependencies).

The hetero-GNN relation table accepts ClinGen and OMIM shares_disease and KEGG and Reactome shares_pathway sources: curated disease information excluded from the tabular census can re-enter as graph topology.

GNN edges are selected on STRING's combined score, which integrates the curated-database channel (KEGG, Reactome, BioCyc) and literature text mining, and the database channel is itself an edge attribute.
codon_position holds (aa_pos - 1) % 3 + 1 from the first digit run of protein_change, overwritten by the unbounded residue index protein_pos wherever protein coordinates exist.

The splice-context pipeline runs during annotation but gates on is_splice and consequence_severity, which engineer_features creates afterwards; every row receives the defaults (Run 15's annotated rows carry neither column; four of its five outputs were constant).

An absent source becomes positive evidence (stage 1D-1b.2, measured by execution). engineer_features fills an absent REVEL with 0.5 and flags revel_score >= 0.5, so revel_pathogenic is 1 and n_tools_pathogenic counts it; fills an absent allele frequency with 0.0, which sets af_is_absent and af_is_ultra_rare (PM2-like rarity from missing data); fills an absent ref or alt with 'A', which sets is_snv (docs/census/SOURCE_ABSENCE_1D1b2.json). On the Run 15 cohort (1,490,014 rows, docs/census/PILOTS_1D1b2.json): 1,169,388 rows (78.5%) have no REVEL score and are all flagged pathogenic, so 90.1% of benign rows carry revel_pathogenic = 1; 497,970 rows (33.4%) have no gnomAD frequency and are all 'ultra-rare', and the missing frequency alone separates the labels (67.0% of pathogenic against 27.9% of benign rows; AUROC 0.695). No cohort row lacks ref or alt, so is_snv is latent there. Fix: stage 1D-1c (observed-only derivation, columns.DERIVED_RULES).

DataPrepPipeline._join_gnomad's locus parse drops a first field that is not digits once X, Y and M are removed, as a prefix: 'X' becomes '' and ''.isdigit() is False, so every chromosome-X gnomAD record (91,771 of 2,951,148 in gnomad_v4_exomes.parquet) is discarded and all 63,929 chromosome-X cohort rows get no frequency -- then 0.0 and 'ultra-rare' (ABSENCE-AS-EVIDENCE-1). Autosomes join: 990,350 of 1,424,307 observed, Run 15's logged count exactly (docs/census/PILOTS_1D1b2.json). Fix: stage 1D-1c.

41 of the 3,211 EVE files do not resolve entry name -> HGNC and are keyed by their filename prefix (BRCA1_BRCT_HUMAN and BRCA1_RING_HUMAN both become BRCA1); 10,982 (gene, substitution) keys are then scored more than once, always with different scores, and EVEConnector._annotate's left join multiplies every matching cohort row: with EVE configured, 280 Run 15 cohort rows would each appear twice (1,490,294 rows for 1,490,014). Latent: Run 15 ran EVE unconfigured. The shadow materialiser records these rows as bad_mapping (ambiguous_source_record) instead (docs/census/PILOTS_1D1b2.json).
The production GTEx path (bulk parquet) writes the defaults for the three variant-level eQTL features; only the per-gene API path, which no launcher uses, computes them.

StringDBGraph.build adds one nx.Graph edge per DIRECTED record, so the reverse record of a pair silently overwrites the forward one's attributes, and no check finds a missing reciprocal, a contradictory direction or a duplicate; the 1D-1b.1 order-independent digest accepted a pair duplicated in both directions. Stage 1D-1b.3 reads the file in ONE verified pass and matches the two directions of every pair EXACTLY in disk-backed partitions, refusing every deviation (graph_identity.read_string_pairs). Measured on STRING v12 human (sha256 28a2ea3b): 13,715,404 records = 6,857,702 pairs x 2, every pair symmetric, 19,622 proteins; content identical for 16, 64 and 256 partitions; 61.0-64.1 s, 621-819 MiB peak (re-measured with the stage 1D-1b.4 read-only buffers), 342,885,100 bytes of scratch on a 2-core container (docs/census/STRING_READER_BENCHMARK_1D1b3.json).

A channel-restricted STRING graph rebuilt from the exported integers is not exactly defined by them: rounded channels with a floored combined score is the best-supported storage model (fits 6,857,369 of 6,857,702 pairs; 333 miss by one thousandth), the restricted reconstruction has 3 pairs outside the published graph, and near the threshold the selection depends on rounding. Stage 1D-1b.3 defines G1 = reconstruction >= 0.700 INTERSECTED with the published graph, compares in integer thousandths, decides every comparison within floating-point error of the threshold in exact rational arithmetic (52 pairs reconstruct to exactly 0.700), and records the four-way status (owner ruling 7f4b69d0, section 7): selected robust 84,874, selected sensitive 113, excluded sensitive 64 (published passes) + 9 (fails), excluded robust 151,879 + 6,620,763; G1 84,987 pairs, G2 236,930 (graph_identity.classify_threshold).

StringDBGraph maps a protein to its STRING preferred name, keeps an unmapped protein under its protein identifier and merges proteins that share a name; its graph cache is keyed by the threshold alone (string_graph_{threshold}.pkl), so it returned the cached 236,930-edge graph when given a different links file, and its names and links caches carry no identity at all. Preferred names are not canonical identity (ruling 7f4b69d0, section 9.1): against HGNC (sha256 69bb5722) 18,837 proteins resolve by approved symbol and 479 by a unique previous symbol, 1 ambiguously, 382 not at all, and 4 HGNC identifiers are claimed by two proteins AFTER canonicalisation (resolved by approved-symbol precedence, graph_identity.map_string_proteins); 250 Run 15 cohort symbols (8,324 rows) reach a STRING node only through their HGNC identifier. Stage 1D-1b.3 binds a graph to a policy and to its computed materialisation (source, mapping, node universe, relation policy, edge content); stage 1D-1b.4 accepts it only when it is exactly the graph re-derived from the pinned files (graph_identity.accept_graph).

evidence_refs: code:src/genomic_variant_classifier/data/kg_edges.py#gs = list(dict.fromkeys(g for g in genes if (allow is None or g in allow)))
registered_defects.statement: kg_edges.co_membership_edges removes out-of-cohort genes BEFORE applying max_set_size, so a pathway's edges exist or vanish with the cohort's composition. Measured on ReactomePathways.gmt (sha256 cf17607f) and the Run 15 splits: the training-gene universe gives 732,550 edges; adding the validation and test genes, as the run driver does, DELETES 180,843 train-train edges and adds none. Stage 1D-1b.3 caps and weights by the GLOBAL canonical set size, w = 1/(|S_s| - 1), so growing the universe never removes or reweights an edge (graph_identity.project_pathways; induced-subgraph consistency measured on the same data: 0 removed, 0 added, 0 reweighted).

load_kg_edge_specs merges every source mapped to one relation into one edge set (Reactome and KEGG into shares_pathway; ClinGen and OMIM into shares_disease), so a withheld and an excluded source cannot be told apart per edge. Stage 1D-1b.3 keys relations by (source, relation) and pathways by (source, stable pathway id) (graph_identity.GeneSetSource).

The run driver builds the hetero-GNN node universe from the union of the training, validation and test genes read from the persisted splits, and restricts every relation to it, so the test split's composition shapes the training graph's nodes and, through KG-COHORT-DEPENDENT-PROJECTION-1, deletes 180,843 Reactome train-train edges (no labels move, but split identity reaches training). Stage 1D-1b.3's graphs use the source-defined universe (GraphPolicy.node_universe = global_source); a cohort is an induced view.

The gene-disjoint split groups rows by gene SYMBOL, so two symbols of one gene can fall on both sides. Measured on the Run 15 cohort and splits: 26 HGNC identifiers appear under two symbols and 14 of them straddle training and held-out (e.g. HGNC:4166 as GAS8 in training and DRC4 in test; HGNC:1152 as BVES and POPDC1); the 1D-1b.3 one-gene rule refuses the 206 training rows of those 14 genes, and the stage 1D-1b.4 component authority excludes all 206 among the 128,435 training rows whose component holds a held-out row (docs/census/POPULATION_ISOLATION_1D1b4.json). Owner: stage 1D-1d (canonical gene and split identities).

One gene identity per row cannot represent a variant listed under several genes. Measured on the Run 15 cohort: 729 gene fields are multi-gene lists (1,838 rows, e.g. 'ABCC8;KCNJ11'); read as canonical gene SETS, 419 HGNC genes lie on both sides of the split, 113,568 training rows touch a held-out gene and 82,999 held-out rows touch a training gene; union-find over genes linked by such lists gives 16,599 components (largest 11 genes, 19,985 rows: no giant component), of which 309 straddle the split -- 660 genes, 219,128 rows. On the three split manifests, with variant identity included (docs/census/POPULATION_ISOLATION_1D1b4.json): 16,964 components (16,599 gene groups and 365 rows with no resolved gene), 327 spanning partitions; shared genes and components training-validation 145 and 115, training-test 291 and 229, validation-test 54 and 53; no variant identifier and no (chrom, pos, ref, alt) repeats. Stage 1D-1b.4 represents a row by its gene SET (population.PopulationRow) and authorizes a fit by component (population.authorize_fit); the production split is unchanged. Owner: 1D-1d (split groups built from components; which loci bind a group is the owner's decision).

labels.discover_label_sites finds only the graph builders' label column and label_col/label_column parameters (12 reviewed sites); it does not discover labels passed as y arrays, positional arguments or other names, so it is a regression detector, never a complete label-access audit. Stage 1D-1b.4 adds the claims and evidence interfaces (claims.ClaimsAuthority) and per-fit read receipts (labels.TrainingLabels), in shadow: no legacy consumer uses them. Owner: 1D-3, where the legacy consumers are replaced by fold-scoped capabilities.

evidence_refs: code:src/genomic_variant_classifier/information_sources/graph_identity.py#        winners = [p for p in ps if first[p][1] is MappingStatus.APPROVED_SYMBOL]
registered_defects.statement: The canonical STRING mapping resolves the 4 HGNC identifiers claimed by two proteins by keeping the approved-symbol protein and discarding the other, which may remove real protein-level evidence (isoforms, distinct products). Owner: 1D-3: keep the protein graph intact and derive gene-level edges by a declared, evidence-preserving aggregation.

train_gnn_pipeline early-stops on train_test_split(np.arange(n), test_size=test_split, random_state=42, stratify=y): a ROW-level split of the focal training rows with no groups (the run driver passes test_split=0.15). The same call on Run 15's 1,038,974 training rows: 155,488 of the 155,847 early-stopping rows (99.77%) share a gene symbol with the inner training rows and 155,510 share a split component, and 7,543 of their 7,860 symbols are inner-training symbols, so checkpoint selection rewards memorised genes. Repair (owner 1D-3): population.component_checkpoint_split, component-disjoint and class-stratified (on the 910,273 component-authorized rows: inner validation 13.319% positive against 13.320% overall) (docs/census/POPULATION_ISOLATION_1D1b4.json).

32 Run 15 rows (29 training, 1 validation, 2 test; 10 distinct fields) carry ClinVar's description of a large variant in gene_symbol instead of gene symbols (e.g. 'covers 26 genes, none of which curated to show dosage sensitivity'). The split groups by the raw field (gene_symbol, missing values filled with 'unknown'), so each description is one 'gene' group and the genes it covers bind nothing; the stage 1D-1b.4 resolver (population.resolve_gene_field) flags them as prose and leaves the rows gene-incomplete, never authorized. Their consequence values (13 intronic, 9 missense, 4 3' UTR, 2 synonymous, 1 non-coding transcript, 1 splice donor, 2 none) are to be checked against the ClinVar records. Owner: 1D-1d (recover the covered genes from the ClinVar record, or exclude the rows by a declared rule).
